rules.title: Mandatory Document Completeness
rules.description: Verifies that all mandatory documents required for the given application category are uploaded and readable.
rules.explanation: AICTE Approval Process Handbook mandates complete submission of statutory affidavits and structural certificates before scrutiny.

rules.title: Certificate Validity & Expiry
rules.description: Ensures statutory safety certificates (Fire Safety, Building Occupancy) remain valid for the entire academic approval cycle.
rules.explanation: Safety certificates expired prior to academic cycle start pose non-compliance risk for student admissions.

rules.title: Institution Identity Verification
rules.description: Cross-verifies extracted institution name, AICTE ID, and trust name against master institutional registration records.
rules.explanation: Identifiers must correspond precisely to prevent unauthorized representation or cross-entity application blending.

rules.title: Intake Expansion Ceiling & Accreditation Prerequisite
rules.description: Validates that requested intake increase does not exceed 50% threshold and requires valid NBA accreditation for expanded courses.
rules.explanation: APH guidelines stipulate NBA accreditation of at least 50% eligible courses prior to sanctioned intake expansion.

rules.title: Technical Education Regulatory (TER) Payment Clearance
rules.description: Verifies confirmation of complete TER processing fee payment through payment gateway or treasury challan.
rules.explanation: Non-exempt applications without confirmed TER fee credit cannot be scheduled for committee scrutiny.

rules.title: Cross-Institutional Document Fingerprint Reuse
rules.description: Calculates cryptographic perceptual hash of architectural drawings and certificates to detect duplicate reuse across different colleges.
rules.explanation: Flagged instances where identical floor plans or safety certificates are submitted by unrelated institutions indicate potential document recycling.

rules.title: Digital Manipulation & Edit-Trace Screening
rules.description: Inspects PDF structural xref tables, font dictionaries, and modification timestamps for post-issuance alterations.
rules.explanation: Secondary modification artifacts or conflicting producer software signatures signal potential digital tampering requiring manual scrutiny.

rules.title: Infrastructure Geotagging & Area Sufficiency
rules.description: Verifies metadata location coordinates on laboratory photographs and matches floor plan area against minimum norms.
rules.explanation: Mandated geo-tagged photographic evidence prevents submission of stock or off-campus facility photos.
